name: PureAutoCodeQL
description: A multi-agent approach to vulnerability analysis with CodeQL, connecting CVE intelligence, source–sink modeling and cross-file path exploration.

feature.question: How can code-audit agents trace vulnerabilities across files?
feature.method: CodeQL source–sink modeling with CVE-guided analysis.
feature.evidence: SARIF, QL queries, selected paths and a run manifest preserve a reviewable trail.
